title: The Electronic Front Page
purpose: The morning newspaper arrives on the television: an invented city daily's videotext front page, three stories with drawn icons and the page number to key for each.
style: Broadsheet masthead in red and cream over ruled story rows, poster-flat icons
techniques: WAIT, then the planned bridge in dashed arc and line
a picture repainted after a WAIT so the rocket lifts off

title: Weather Map of the Westmark
purpose: The afternoon forecast map of an invented prairie region: town symbols, temperatures, and a cold front that arrives last.
style: Flat green land on a deep blue sea, symbols as programmable characters, cream temperature tags
techniques: DRCS weather symbols overlaid in two colours
the same DRCS symbols reused small in the outlook
rain area in a defined texture of drops, shimmering with the rain entry

title: Storm Warning
purpose: A severe-weather bulletin pushed to every set in two counties: the sky over the farms, a flashing bolt and the watch in red.
style: Bruised green storm sky over black farm silhouettes, alarm-red bulletin panel
techniques: BLINK lightning hidden in the sky colour
BLINK sky flash on the same beat
banded sky with scud and shelf cloud
BLINK bands that turn the funnel

title: Market Close
purpose: A stockbroker's quotation page at the close: the day's index climbing hour by hour, then ten invented shares with their moves.
style: Green-screen trading terminal: amber headings, phosphor-green chart over a dark grid
techniques: WAIT reveal of the index hour by hour
headline figure repainted at each hour
native vertical hatching under the line
BLINK closing marker and ringing bell
BLINK pulsing the most active row
hatching over a solid fill for two-tone shading

title: Last Night's Scores
purpose: The morning sports page: last night's extra-inning game told by pennants, a ballpark and a ten-inning line score, with the other results below.
style: Night ballpark in grass green and infield tan, wooden scoreboard with yellow figures
techniques: two defined dot textures for the crowd
a third texture of unlit bulbs on the board
WAIT replays the line score inning by inning

title: The Community Almanac
purpose: A provincial statistics bureau puts its census on the television: towns by population as rising bars, and the region's farms by type as a hatched pie.
style: Government report on cream paper: teal band, blue bars, period hatching in the pie
techniques: WAIT as each row is counted
isotype rows of a DRCS figure drawn with REPEAT
native vertical, horizontal and cross hatching over solid fills

title: Ask the Encyclopedia: Volcanoes
purpose: A home encyclopedia on the television: a volcano cut open, layer by layer, then the eruption, with every part named on a leader line.
style: Textbook cross-section in earth browns and lava reds under a dusk sky
techniques: magma rising up the vent in WAIT steps
dotted arcs for the bombs' paths

title: City Directory: Hotels
purpose: The electronic city directory a visitor consults before booking: downtown hotels with addresses, telephone numbers, stars and tonight's free rooms.
style: Dusk skyline whose windows light up, over a cream directory card with coloured availability dots
techniques: colour-map change after WAIT lights every window and its reflection at once
BLINK beacon, sign and last-room dot

title: Your Own Newspaper
purpose: The newspaper the futurists promised: only the topics one reader chose, gathered each morning into coloured folders with her name on the masthead.
style: Plum desk with four pastel file folders, each with a coloured tab and a flat drawing
techniques: WAIT as each folder is filed
DRCS frost crystal at two sizes

title: The Night Sky Tonight
purpose: An almanac page for a hobby club: tonight's sky as a dome over the rooftops, with the planets named, the Moon's phase and the times to go out and look.
style: Deep blue dome in concentric bands over a black roofline, twinkling stars, gold labels
techniques: dusk turned to night by four colour-map changes after a WAIT
Milky Way in two defined speckle textures
three BLINKs with staggered delays for twinkling
Moon phase from two arcs and a halo ring
entry 0 freed and recoloured for a meteor that BLINK flashes
